property_summary: For every assertionId the reference contract returns AssertionPolicy.arbitrateViaEscalationManager == false, whereas the mutant sets it to true for some assertionId values causing the returned policy's arbitrateViaEscalationManager field to differ; the test fuzzes assertionId and checks that arbitrateViaEscalationManager is false (which holds for the reference for all inputs) and will fail on the mutant for inputs where it returns true.
change_summary: Change returned AssertionPolicy to require arbitration via escalation manager (set arbitrateViaEscalationManager to true).
